widget.name: MxDynamicGrid
widget.description: Data grid whose columns are runtime data: users add, rename, retype, reorder, pin, hide and delete typed fields and edit rows. Data Grid 2 and AG Grid features: filters, sorting, paging, selection, range selection, fill handle, paste, undo, grouping, totals, record form, validation, saved views, Excel and CSV export and import. Changes are written as a JSON change set to a save action.

property.caption: Columns
property.description: One object per dynamic column (for example GridColumn objects of the grid). The widget reads the column definition from the attributes below.

property.caption: Key
property.description: Unique, stable key of the column. Row values in the row JSON are stored under this key.

property.caption: Type
property.description: Field type, case-insensitive: text, longText, number, decimal, currency, percent, date, dateTime, boolean, select, multiSelect, rating, progress, link, email, phone, user, formula, autoNumber, createdAt, changedAt, createdBy, changedBy. For an enumeration the key is used.

property.caption: Sort order
property.description: Position of the column; lower values come first.

property.caption: Width
property.description: Default width in pixels. Empty or 0 uses a width that suits the type.

property.caption: Pinned
property.description: Default pinning: none, left or right (case-insensitive).

property.caption: Hidden
property.description: Hidden by default; users can show it in the columns panel.

property.caption: Required
property.description: A value is required in every row.

property.caption: Read-only
property.description: Values of this column cannot be edited.

property.caption: Options (JSON)
property.description: Options of select and multi select columns as JSON: a list of objects with value, label and color. Also holds the rating maximum and the default value of other types as an object with max and default.

property.caption: Format
property.description: Number or date format, for example 0.00, #,##0, € #,##0.00, 0.0% or dd-MM-yyyy. Empty uses the session locale.

property.caption: Formula
property.description: Formula of formula columns. Columns are referenced by key in square brackets, for example [price] * [qty].

property.caption: Header group
property.description: Adjacent columns with the same header group share one spanning header.

property.caption: Validation (JSON)
property.description: Validation rules as JSON with the optional fields min, max, regex, unique and message.

property.caption: Can edit
property.description: Per-column permission set by the data source microflow; false makes the column read-only for this user.

property.caption: Rows
property.description: One object per row (for example GridRow objects of the grid).

property.caption: Row key
property.description: Unique, stable key of the row.

property.caption: Row data (JSON)
property.description: JSON object with the values of the row keyed by column key (String, unlimited length).

property.caption: Row order
property.description: Position of the row when the grid is not sorted.

property.caption: Data mode
property.description: Client: all rows are loaded and sorted, filtered and grouped in the browser. Server: the rows source is paged; sorting and filtering on dynamic columns are sent through the view state attribute. Auto: client below the threshold, server above it.

property.caption: Client threshold
property.description: Auto data mode: above this number of rows the grid switches to server mode.

property.caption: Search attribute
property.description: Server mode: a String attribute of the rows (for example SearchText) that quick search filters with contains.

property.caption: View state
property.description: Server mode: String attribute of the context object that receives the search, sort, filters, offset and limit as JSON before the rows source is reloaded. Use it in a microflow data source that pages itself.

property.caption: Total count
property.description: Server mode with a view state: attribute of the context object holding the total number of matching rows.

property.caption: Row class
property.description: CSS class(es) added to the row, evaluated per row.

property.caption: Empty placeholder
property.description: Widgets shown when there are no rows.

property.caption: Linkable rows
property.description: Rows that linked-record fields can point to (for example the rows of other grids). Lookup and rollup fields read their data.

property.caption: Key
property.description: Row key of a linkable row.

property.caption: Label
property.description: Name shown for a linked row.

property.caption: Data (JSON)
property.description: Row JSON of the linkable row, used by lookup and rollup fields.

property.caption: Grid
property.description: Optional: the grid a linkable row belongs to, so a link field can target one grid.

property.caption: Comments
property.description: Comments on rows and cells. New comments and resolves are sent as addComment and resolveComment ops in the change set.

property.caption: Column key
property.description: Key of the commented field; empty for a comment on the whole row.

property.caption: History
property.description: Change history shown as a timeline in the record view (who, when, field, old and new value).

property.caption: Old value
property.description: Value before the change (as text or JSON).

property.caption: New value
property.description: Value after the change (as text or JSON).

property.caption: Changed by
property.description: Name of the user who made the change.

property.caption: Operation
property.description: Change-set op name, for example setCell or addRow.

property.caption: Refresh interval (seconds)
property.description: Reloads the rows, columns and comments every given number of seconds so changes by other users appear. 0 turns polling off.

property.caption: Row changed by
property.description: Name of the user who last changed the row; shown as Updated by when another user changed it.

property.caption: Row changed at
property.description: When the row was last changed.

property.caption: Presence
property.description: Users currently viewing the grid, as a comma separated list or JSON array, shown as avatars.

property.caption: Row locked
property.description: Locked rows show a padlock and cannot be edited, moved or deleted.

property.caption: Static columns
property.description: Data Grid 2 style columns over attributes of the row objects, shown next to the dynamic columns.

property.caption: Show
property.description: Attribute, dynamic text or custom content widgets.

property.caption: Header group
property.description: Adjacent columns with the same header group share one spanning header.

property.caption: Position
property.description: Before or after the dynamic columns.

property.caption: Pinned
property.description: Keeps the column visible while scrolling horizontally.

property.caption: Sortable
property.description: Users can sort on this column (attribute columns).

property.caption: Filterable
property.description: Shows a header filter (attribute and dynamic text columns).

property.caption: Editable
property.description: Attribute columns: values can be edited; they are written to the object through the Mendix client and committed.

property.caption: Attribute name (editing)
property.description: Only needed for editing when the widget cannot tell which attribute to write. Enter the attribute name, for example Status.

property.caption: Selection
property.description: Whether the user can select one row, several rows, or none.

property.caption: Selection checkboxes
property.description: Shows a checkbox column and a select-all checkbox (multi selection).

property.caption: Select all pages
property.description: Select all selects the rows of every page, like Data Grid 2. In server mode the status bar offers to select all matching rows.

property.caption: Change set
property.description: String attribute (unlimited) of the context object that receives the change set JSON before On save runs. Required when editing is on.

property.caption: On save
property.description: Microflow or nanoflow that applies the change set to the database. Required when editing is on.

property.caption: Result
property.description: Optional String attribute the save microflow fills with a result JSON: ok, version and errors per row and column. Errors are shown on the cells.

property.caption: Version
property.description: Optional Integer attribute of the context object for optimistic concurrency; sent as baseVersion.

property.caption: Save mode
property.description: Auto: changes are saved after a short pause. Manual: a save bar with Save and Discard (Ctrl+S).

property.caption: Auto save delay (ms)
property.description: Auto save: changes made within this time are saved together.

property.caption: Block invalid save
property.description: Do not save while edited rows have invalid cells.

property.caption: Can edit data
property.description: Whether the user can edit cell values.

property.caption: Can edit structure
property.description: Whether the user can add, change, reorder and delete columns.

property.caption: Can add rows
property.description: Whether the user can add rows (also by paste and import).

property.caption: Can delete rows
property.description: Whether the user can delete rows.

property.caption: Can export
property.description: Whether the user can export and import.

property.caption: Single click edit
property.description: Starts editing with one click instead of a double click, Enter or typing.

property.caption: Enter adds a row
property.description: Pressing Enter after editing the last row adds a new row.

property.caption: Range selection
property.description: Drag or Shift+click to select a block of cells; copy, paste, clear and see aggregates.

property.caption: Fill handle
property.description: Drag the corner of a range to fill cells; continues number and date series.

property.caption: Row drag
property.description: Drag rows to reorder them (client mode, not sorted or grouped).

property.caption: Undo steps
property.description: Number of actions that can be undone. 0 turns undo off.

property.caption: View bar
property.description: Labelled view bar with Hide fields, Filter, Sort, Group, Color, Row height, search, save status, import, export and New row.

property.caption: Hide fields button
property.description: View bar button to show and hide fields. Users can still hide a field from its column menu.

property.caption: Filter button
property.description: View bar button with the filter builder. Off also removes 'Filter by this field' from the column menu; header filters and search stay as configured.

property.caption: Sort button
property.description: View bar button with the multi-level sort. Users can still sort by clicking a header.

property.caption: Group button
property.description: View bar button to group rows. Only shown when Grouping is on.

property.caption: Color button
property.description: View bar button to colour rows by a field or by conditions.

property.caption: Row height button
property.description: View bar button to choose short, medium, tall or extra tall rows.

property.caption: More menu (⋮)
property.description: The ⋮ menu next to the view bar buttons (command palette, print, keyboard shortcuts and similar).

property.caption: Export button
property.description: Export button in the view bar. Off keeps export in the command palette; set Export to None to switch export off completely.

property.caption: New row button
property.description: New row button in the view bar. Off keeps New row in the command palette (Ctrl+K) for users who may add rows.

property.caption: View tabs
property.description: Tabs for the saved views above the view bar. Needs the Saved views attribute.

property.caption: Freeze first field
property.description: Keeps the first (primary) field visible while scrolling horizontally.

property.caption: Templates
property.description: A grid without fields offers templates (tasks, contacts, inventory, budget by month, blank) to start from.

property.caption: Onboarding hints
property.description: Shows a short three-step introduction the first time a user opens the grid (remembered in the browser).

property.caption: Command palette
property.description: Ctrl+K opens a searchable list of grid actions, plus the undo history.

property.caption: Board, calendar and gallery views
property.description: Users can create board (kanban), calendar and gallery views next to grid views.

property.caption: Quick search
property.description: Search box that filters all columns.

property.caption: Header filters
property.description: Filter row under the headers, by type (text, number range, date range, option set, yes or no).

property.caption: Columns panel
property.description: Side panel to show, hide, reorder and pin columns.

property.caption: Grouping
property.description: Users can group rows by up to three columns, with aggregates per group.

property.caption: Keyboard help
property.description: Toolbar button (and the ? key) that lists the keyboard shortcuts.

property.caption: Row numbers
property.description: Shows a row number column with the expand-record button.

property.caption: Totals footer
property.description: Footer row with an aggregate per column; users choose sum, average, min, max, count or filled.

property.caption: Status bar
property.description: Row count, selection count, aggregates of the selected cells and the save state.

property.caption: Pagination
property.description: Paging buttons, virtual scrolling (loads more while scrolling) or a load more button.

property.caption: Page size
property.description: Rows per page (and per load in server mode).

property.caption: Page size options
property.description: Comma separated page sizes the user can choose; empty hides the selector.

property.caption: Export
property.description: Export formats offered in the toolbar.

property.caption: Keep grid colours
property.description: Default of the "Keep grid colours" choice in the export dialog: the Excel file gets the row colours, select option colours and conditional formats the grid shows. Users can turn it off per export. CSV is always plain.

property.caption: File name
property.description: File name without extension; [date] is replaced by the current date.

property.caption: Sheet name
property.description: Name of the Excel sheet; [date] is replaced by the current date.

property.caption: Excel title
property.description: Optional title row above the Excel table, followed by the export date and time.

property.caption: CSV byte order mark
property.description: Starts the CSV with a UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel detects the encoding.

property.caption: CSV dates
property.description: Dates in ISO 8601 or in the column format.

property.caption: Escape formulas
property.description: Protects against formula injection: text values starting with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return are prefixed with a single quote in CSV files and Excel text cells.

property.caption: Import
property.description: Users can import rows from CSV and Excel files, mapping file columns to fields or creating new fields.

property.caption: Personalization
property.description: String attribute (unlimited) that stores the user's column layout, sorting, filters, grouping, totals and formatting as JSON.

property.caption: On personalization change
property.description: Runs after the personalization attribute changed, for example to commit the object.

property.caption: Saved views
property.description: String attribute (unlimited) that stores the named views as JSON. Shows a Views menu.

property.caption: On views change
property.description: Runs after the views attribute changed, for example to commit the object.

property.caption: Current user name
property.description: Name of the current user; personal views are only shown to their owner. Empty treats every view as visible.

property.caption: Color scheme
property.description: Light, dark, or follow the operating system.

property.caption: Accent color
property.description: Brand color for focus, selection and buttons.

property.caption: Density
property.description: Deprecated since 1.1: use Row height. Kept for compatibility.

property.caption: Height
property.description: CSS height of the grid, for example 600px or 70vh.

property.caption: Height mode
property.description: Fixed: the Height property. Fill parent: takes the height of the parent container. Auto: grows with the rows up to the maximum height.

property.caption: Maximum height
property.description: Auto height mode: the grid grows with its rows up to this CSS height, then scrolls.

property.caption: Row height
property.description: Initial row height; users change it in the view bar. Extra tall wraps long text.

property.caption: Motion
property.description: Animations: full, subtle or off. Always off when the user prefers reduced motion.
